title: Reward of 500 coins and a trophy sword
description: A bounty pays 500 coins and a trophy sword. Target behaviour: the job is recorded, the hero receives 500 coins once and a sword that is a weapon. Current bounds: job and grant currency 1–20, created items only food/supply/misc (the schema has no weapon category). The model sees these limits in its context and works within them.

steps.say: The organiser posts a bounty: clear the wolves off the north road for 500 coins and a trophy sword from the guild armoury. I take it.

model.note: Limit-aware model: 500 coins and a weapon cannot be job terms; the contract is marked unsupported instead of recording false terms.

effects.description: Record the wolf bounty job from the organiser: 500 coins plus a trophy sword (beyond bounded job terms).

beats.text: The organiser pins the bounty up with a knife. "Five hundred coins and a sword from the armoury. The guild wants that road open."

visualDescription.text: A bounty notice pinned with a knife.

steps.say: Three days later I come back with the wolf pelts and claim the bounty: 500 coins and the trophy sword.

model.note: Limit-aware model: the 500 coins exceed the bound (unsupported); the sword can only be minted as a misc item via mundane_grant.

effects.description: Pay the 500-coin wolf bounty (exceeds the 20-coin bound).

effects.itemDescription: A guild trophy sword with a wolf's head on the pommel.

beats.text: The organiser counts the pelts twice and whistles.
From under the counter he lifts a sword with a wolf's-head pommel. "Guild's thanks."

visualDescription.text: A sword with a wolf's-head pommel on a counter.
